test_quantized_distribution: test the Quantized distribution class against TFP for equivalence of sample, log_prob, and cdf methods
test_quantized_sample_shape: test the Quantized distribution sampling with various sample shapes including empty, int, and tuple shapes
test_quantized_log_prob: test the Quantized distribution log_prob method with cutoff parameters and edge cases for integer and array values
test_quantized_slicing: test the Quantized distribution getitem slicing method to verify batch shape and event shape are preserved correctly
test_quantized_survival_consistency: test that the Quantized distribution survival_function equals 1 minus cdf across all cutoff configurations
